Rogue Wave at Royale

with Midlake, Peter Wolf Crier

  • Sep 26, 2010
  • Boston, Massachusetts

I went for Midlake.

It was a great time for Midlake. They played mostlty songs from Van Occupanther and the singles from The Courage of Others. Flute harmonies and forest rock.

Rogue Wave

It was sort of an odd matchup. Rogue Wave represented the 2010’s era of dance indie, with the hit Good Morning-The Future, which was an honest banger. Their older catalog was more of a fit; more along the lines of their SubPop peers The Shins.
